description:
# Master compliance for opi-q5k.10

Source check: opi-q5k.10 (markdown.test.ts audit)

Upstream `tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/markdown.test.ts` has 52 tests across 13 describes. Our Markdown covers ~30% (basic headings, inline formatting, flat lists, basic blockquote, hr, basic links, strikethrough). Substantial implementation gaps remain for: tables (no implementation), nested lists, heading+inline-code preservation, pre-styled context, spacing invariants, multiline blockquotes, HTML pass-through, and OSC 8 hyperlinks.

## Children

One ticket per upstream describe area. Each is independent and blocks this master (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

## Deps
- Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).
- OSC 8 hyperlink child soft-depends on opi-q5k.34 (capability detection).
title: Port markdown.test.ts gaps (master — 13 describe areas)
